big_case.notes: Self-represented applicants seeking a temporary stay of a writ of possession in a private foreclosure dispute with U.S. Bank, arising from a remanded S.D. Fla. removal with an Eleventh Circuit stay motion pending; no federal question of general importance; denied in chambers by the Circuit Justice without response or referral.
